display_title: Drive installed preflight through creation UI

installed_check.step: Clean NSIS install, actual installed window, ACL and uninstall

verified_scope: Clean x64 NSIS installation and the installed packaged window completed successfully.
The installed preflight script can return success only when canonical runtime isolation, the synthetic UI-unlock check, every denial case, measured retry, and file-preservation checks all pass.
The active creation screen is driven through its prepare UI and agent-hit UI; agent-hit uses the installed task IPC/shared runner and bundled Python.
Denial cases cover unknown/insufficient RAM, disk and VRAM, plus unbudgeted MusicGen; synthetic resource values are used to exercise fail-closed branches.
Measured retry uses the Windows runner inventory and stays explicitly inventory-only/procedural DSP; inference and product quality are not accepted.
limitations: Bootstrap response is test-only and only unlocks the generation action; no engine/model installation or setup acceptance is claimed.
Synthetic denial measurements prove enforcement on the installed path, not behavior on a physically low-memory/low-VRAM machine.
No CUDA/AMD model inference or song-quality acceptance is established by this run.
